## Description

Rank commodity futures by curve-implied roll return and buy favorable term structures while avoiding unfavorable ones.

## Where it may fit

Commodity markets with persistent curve shape/carry differences and disciplined contract rolls.

## Vehicles

Commodity futures, CTA, managed-futures and diversified alternatives funds.

## Required data

Multiple futures maturities, settlements, contract specifications, collateral yield, rolls and transaction costs.

## Caveats

Curve signal definitions and roll schedules vary; backwardation/contango alone does not guarantee returns.
